item.title: Montana Republican US Sen. Steve Daines drops reelection bid in surprise move
item.description: BILLINGS, Mont. (AP) — Republican U.S. Sen. Steve Daines of Montana dropped his bid for reelection to a third term in a surprise withdrawal just minutes before a Wednesday filing deadline for candidates.

item.title: Carney says Canada, Australia hold 'rare convening power' in Parliament speech
item.description: CANBERRA — Canada and Australia have a "rare" ability to help convene a coalition of middle powers because their allies know they can be trusted, Prime Minister Mark Carney said in a speech to Australia's Parliament on Thursday.

item.description: VANCOUVER — A meteor that NASA says soared across the night sky above Metro Vancouver at about 100 times the speed of sound set off a fireball, a sonic boom and an explosive response online.

item.title: Polls open in Nepal’s first election after last year's youth-led protests toppled the government
item.description: KATHMANDU, Nepal (AP) — Polls opened Thursday in Nepal's first nationwide election since last year’s violent, youth-led uprising forced the government from power.
